headline: AI-chip rout: CRDO -10.5%, QCOM/ADI -8%, NXPI/KEYS -7.6%, LRCX/MRVL -5-6%, CAT -5.5%. SK Hynix HBM4 slowdown + Broadcom capex miss. CWAN merger-arb closed June 25 at $24.55.

Persisting AI-chip rout (Friday June 26 close, pre-market Monday). LRCX and MRVL escalated to RED on thesis cross-check. CAT improving — tariff revised down to $2.2-2.4B, pre-market bounce. CRDO stabilized. Hyperscaler late-July earnings window primary macro risk.

AEM new RED — Q2 gold crash -14% ($4,861→$4,040/oz) matches thesis key_risk #1 (AMBER→RED). MARA/HUT new AMBER on crypto weakness and Q1 EPS miss. STLD new AMBER on Q2 margin squeeze. LRCX/KEYS downgraded AMBER on recovery. CAT + ADI resolved GREEN. MRVL/CRDO/QCOM persisting RED.

First run after a 17-day gap (last run 06-30). Two concurrent shocks: TSMC capex hike (to $60-64B) triggered an AI-ROI selloff hitting MRVL -8.6% and CRDO -8.1% (persisting RED) plus AMD -5.2%/LRCX -4.3% (AMBER); Bitcoin's slide toward $60K hit HUT -10.7% and MARA -6.8% (escalated to RED) and HOOD -8.2% (new RED). CWAN roster-integrity flag unresolved for a 3rd consecutive run. STLD's 06-30 margin-compression AMBER resolved to green — new guidance shows margin expansion, not compression. ABT +10.7% on Q2 beat-and-raise. Next catalyst: GOOG earnings 2026-07-22 (first hyperscaler capex read).

MARA -6.47% and HOOD -5.76% both extend a second session of outsized declines (persisting RED) against Friday's broad selloff (SPY -1.0%, QQQ -1.5%). New AMBER: SYK -3.44% (cyber-recovery concerns resurface), FAST -2.57% (digesting margin miss), TOL -3.19% (rate-sensitivity). CRDO downgraded RED->AMBER as the AI-capex rout stabilizes; HUT, MRVL, AMD, QCOM, VST, SUPV, COIN resolved to green. VLO +3.11% led gainers on Iran-tension crude spike. CWAN roster flag unresolved for a 4th consecutive run. Next: GOOG earnings 07-22.

Weekend escalation in the US-Iran war (2 US troop deaths in Jordan, 8th consecutive night of US strikes on Iran, air-raid sirens in Bahrain) is the dominant new development — markets have been closed since Friday and have not priced it in; crude above $82/bbl, a one-month high. Energy sleeve (VLO, CVX, OKE, DVN, CNX) sits on the tailwind side; broader risk sentiment is the headwind into Monday's open. Friday's session itself carries forward unchanged: MARA (-6.47%) and HOOD (-5.76%) remain persisting RED on thesis-linked risk (Bitcoin-derivative exposure; thin-margin-of-safety credit scrutiny) though weekend Bitcoin action was mildly positive (+1.3% to ~$64.8K). SYK, TOL, CRDO, FAST, LRCX persist AMBER, all thesis- or sector-linked, none escalating. CWAN roster-integrity flag remains unresolved (24 days since deal close). Next catalyst: GOOG earnings 2026-07-22 (Tue) — first hyperscaler capex read of the season, 3 days out.

No new equity session yet (markets open later today) but two names carry fresh, material catalysts into the open: Morgan Stanley cut its MARA price target to $5.50 (from $7, Underweight maintained), and HOOD's consumer-credit expansion (up to $500M in asset-backed securities) continues to draw scrutiny with shares down ~9% on the week toward the $100 level. The Iran war has escalated further overnight — cumulative US troop deaths now reported at 17, a 9th consecutive night of US strikes, and Brent crude briefly topped $90/bbl before easing to $88.54 — a continuing tailwind for the energy sleeve and a geopolitical overhang for broader risk sentiment. GOOG's Q2 earnings (Wed 2026-07-22) is now 2 days out. CWAN roster-integrity flag remains unresolved for a 26th day.
